scientific_integrity: The exact identity and asymptotic dichotomy are proved analytically; 117 finite quadrature and derivative tests are corroboration rather than certification of quantified assertions. Independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Two equal-width separated spectral intervals and one finite observation interval; fixed positive time and bandwidth parameters, large-band-separation asymptotics; no individual eigenvalue characterization, no uniform near-integer transition, and no extension to varying or nonsymmetric bands. A close 2012 bandpass-operator paper was identifiable but full text was unavailable; historical priority is provisional.
title: Separation resonance in the quadratic trace of two-band Fourier concentration
